title: Optimal Control for Steady Circulation of a Diffusion Process via Spectral Decomposition of Fokker-Planck Equation
summary: We present a formulation of an optimal control problem for a two-dimensional diffusion process governed by a Fokker-Planck equation to achieve a nonequilibrium steady state with a desired circulation while accelerating convergence toward the stationary distribution. To achieve the control objective, we introduce costs for both the probability density function and flux rotation to the objective functional.
